text: The message header popup and global View menu own different document nodes. Each reads FeedMessageHandler.onSelectPref and updates its own ordered website, summary and per-folder radio items. The new feed browser test drives both real entry points. This augments the existing feed visibility lesson: a correct preference alone does not prove that a second menu shows the selection. Current checked state uses toggleAttribute and tests use hasAttribute. Manual review proposal for these menus: update and test the menu that the user actually opens; preserve the ordering that maps the preference integer to the item index. This is scoped to feed menus, not a general rule for all radio widgets.
title: Feed menu checks must be set in each popup context
